stories.title: Water supplies hit in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft after burst main
stories.summary: Homes in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft have low pressure or no water after a burst water main, with supplies not expected back to normal until this evening. stories.title: Connah’s Quay darts academy billed as Wales’ biggest aims to find the next Luke Littler
stories.summary: The biggest darts and pool academy in Wales could soon be producing North Wales’ very own Luke Littlers and Gerwyn Prices. After being granted planning permission by Flintshire County Council, work has now begun on Ellis’ Darts – a purpose-built darts and pool academy on Dock Road in Connah’s Quay aimed primarily at young people.

stories.title: 603 people moved to Flintshire from outside the UK, and 754 went the other way, new ONS data shows
stories.summary: More people left Flintshire for countries outside the UK than moved here from them in the twelve months to June 2025, figures published by the Office for National Statistics this morning show. stories.title: “Some relief this morning”: police log a clear night after run of Flintshire fires
stories.summary: North Wales Police officers in north Flintshire reported no arson incidents overnight, after a run of fires in the open across the county. stories.title: Darts venue approved for Connah’s Quay industrial unit despite neighbour’s safety warning
stories.summary: Plans to turn part of a Connah’s Quay industrial unit into an indoor darts venue have been approved, despite a neighbouring business warning of a safety risk in the shared yard.
